subject.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this narrow provider-dispatch rate-limit config slice before the broader outbound API limits design is decided?
rationale: The PR is technically plausible, but it creates public config and runtime policy semantics that automation cannot accept without maintainer product/API direction.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now and let a maintainer reopen or request a fresh narrow PR once the provider-dispatch slice is explicitly approved.

options.title: Sponsor The Provider Slice
options.body: If maintainers want this exact scope, require a rebase onto current main, preserved egress sentinel behavior, regenerated config baselines, and fresh upgrade/fresh-install proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Canonical Design
options.body: Keep the implementation idea as prior art while designing the broader outbound limits, budget, status, and tool/channel policy in the canonical issues.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and let a maintainer reopen or request a fresh narrow PR once the provider-dispatch slice is explicitly approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest adjacent provider egress history and were already identified in the canonical tracker as the likely product/API boundary owner.
